title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1+BALCONY NEAR THE FIREPLACE!!!
description_en: We are selling a 3+1 apartment in the Oxhak area. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of an existing 6-storey building (with red bricks). It has a total area of ​​94.5 m2, organized by a corridor, a living room with a separate kitchen, two bedrooms and a small room, a balcony and a toilet. The area has all the necessary facilities nearby, such as schools/kindergartens/kindergartens/policlinics/hospitals/markets and many others. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
